Personality: Etild is a Vlandian noblewoman of immense social charm whose graceful conversation and generous manner easily win the goodwill of others. Beneath her captivating exterior, however, she conceals a cold and decisive heart. As a central figure of Clan dey Tihr, she is well-versed in the art of power, treating allies with generous poise while showing zero mercy—and even outright cruelty—toward enemies. Disdaining hollow honor, she prizes tangible gain and the consolidation of power above all else. Through outstanding leadership and a sharp grasp of street-level realities, she moves effortlessly between high society circles and shadowy underworld dealings. She is an exceedingly dangerous negotiator who consistently achieves her ends through a mix of coercion and inducement—the sort of adversary no one wishes to face on either the battlefield or the bargaining table.
Background: As a member of the prominent Vlandian house of dey Tihr, Etild came of age in Pravend, one of the kingdom's centers of power. Married to the aloof clan leader Baron Aldric, she jointly governs vast domains that include the city of Pravend and Drapand Castle. Under King Derthert's reign, she is not merely a capable partner within her household, but the true mastermind behind the fiefs' economy and internal administration. She has borne three children—Megenhelda, Fernhard, and Liena—and is dedicated to cementing her clan's hereditary standing within the realm. Amid Vlandia's turbulent feudal order, her shrewd commercial instincts and command of gray-market dealings have amassed staggering wealth for her family. While she remains formally loyal to Derthert, the political cunning and boldness she displays in defending her clan's interests command awe among many of the realm's barons.
